title: Shortest superpermutation on 9 symbols
statement: Find a string over 1..9 that contains every permutation of 1..9 as 9 consecutive characters, as short as possible. The shortest known, by Egan's construction (2019), has length 408966; a shorter one improves it.
submission: Text file: the string, digits 1..9 (whitespace ignored).
score: the length of the string (smaller is better)

best_known.source: L(9) <= 408966: Egan's construction (2019), in Leaps in Bounds (github.com/daniel-munro/leaps-in-bounds), data at commit 4521e13 (8 Nov 2026); read 8 Nov 2026
